notes: Justice League: Rights Edition: gameId justice-league matches registry (export JusticeLeagueGame). 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 35 JSON: 6 cats (know-your-rights/know-the-law/get-justice/rights-in-action/educational-not-advice/your-rights-toolkit), 7 types (branch 19/reflect 18/sort 15/match 13/strike-rewrite 12/spot 4/role-play 3), 0% binary. Rights & redress; empowerment through knowledge; EDUCATIONAL NOT legal advice (plain-language law, demystified redress, real authorities + free legal aid, never promises outcomes). India: constitutional rights, POCSO(18), POSH IC, child-marriage law(18/21), DV Act, cyber-law; routes trusted adult/police(Zero FIR)/Internal Committees/Child Welfare Committees/NALSA legal aid 15100/helplines 1098-181-1091-112-1930 (reassureCats get-justice+your-rights-toolkit+educational-not-advice). binStyle: safe-negation guard += 'not a violation'->green (jl-053 'Not a violation' = safe side); NEG += 'violates'->red (jl-008 'Violates them', jl-053 'Likely violation'); regression-clean (tokens g35-only). Categorisation/corrective bins (what-it-means/what-it-isn't/real-route/in-the-toolkit/112-vs-committee) correctly left neutral. Spot ids injected (4).
